Fit a set of dose-response models

Source: R/fit.R
fit_dose_response_models.Rd

Fit a set of dose-response models

Usage

fit_dose_response_models(
  data,
  models = c("exponential", "beta_poisson"),
  check_trend = TRUE,
  alpha = 0.05
)

Arguments

data

Grouped dose-response data accepted by as_dose_response().

models

Character vector of models to fit, a subset of "exponential", "beta_poisson", and "exact_beta_poisson". Defaults to the exponential and approximate beta-Poisson models; add "exact_beta_poisson" to include the exact model.

check_trend

If TRUE, warn when the increasing trend test does not pass at alpha.

alpha

Significance level used for the passes indicator.

Value

A named qdr_model_set containing one fit per requested model, with the trend result stored in the trend attribute.
